visionReview.reviewScope: targeted parameter family in a fixed scene; not whole-scene approval
visionReview.reason: All pass technical gates, but none meets the reference-led grass quality bar. Radial blade templates and coarse segment curvature are the likely causes; this is a hypothesis supported by the geometry code and visible spike forms. Retain the previous best.

candidates.reason: Reads as grass rather than fern-like cards, but broad radial spikes and a flat olive-gold response are too artificial for the reference.

assessment.silhouette: Broad pointed radial clumps look agave-like
assessment.groundRichness: Coverage improves but center remains flat
assessment.lighting: No black clumps, but olive flatness remains

candidates.reason: Lower triangle cost is a technical gain, but pale skeletal atlas forms look like weeds or debris and are less attractive than the retained baseline.

assessment.lighting: Overly pale vegetation despite acceptable dark-pixel metric

candidates.reason: The strongest relative grass treatment, with finer blades and clearer masses, but still uniformly pointed, rigid and too olive compared with the references.

assessment.biomeIdentity: Best grass silhouette of the three
assessment.silhouette: Fine blades are still sharply segmented
assessment.vegetation: Radial tufts lack coherent flowing lean
assessment.lighting: Readable golden/olive blades, insufficient subtle color hierarchy
assessment.repetition: Template orientation and repeated radial form remain visible
assessment.overallAppeal: Rank first; reject as not good enough
